mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve inverts (10y-2y < 0) within 6 months of signal activation, or 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where GDP y/y growth accelerates.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in industrial production, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in unemployment, signals a supply-driven inflation scare that will pressure the Fed to tighten policy and produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines > 0.5% m/m and UNRATE does not rise
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or the Fed cuts rates within 3 months of signal activation.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in payroll employment, if accompanied by a rise in the unemployment rate, signals a cyclical labor market turning point that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 300k m/m and UNRATE rises > 0.2pp
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or the unemployment rate falls back below its 12-month average within 6 months of signal activation.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the consumer price index, if not offset by a contemporaneous rise in the federal funds rate, signals an inflation overshoot that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL rises > 0.5% m/m and FEDFUNDS does not rise
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or the Fed cuts rates within 3 months of signal activation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in housing starts, if accompanied by a decline in the unemployment rate, signals a strengthening housing market that will boost consumer spending and produce positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST rises > 5% y/y and UNRATE falls > 0.3pp y/y
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or the 10-year Treasury yield rises > 100 bps within 6 months of signal activation.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in retail sales, if not offset by a contemporaneous rise in industrial production, signals a demand-driven growth scare that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS falls > 1% m/m and INDPRO does not rise
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or industrial production rises > 1% within 3 months of signal activation.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous decline in payroll employment, signals a labor market weakening that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.5pp y/y and PAYEMS does not fall
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or payroll employment rises > 200k within 6 months of signal activation.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the federal funds rate, if not accompanied by a contemporaneous rise in consumer prices, signals a monetary policy mistake that will produce negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 50 bps in 3 months and CPIAUCSL does not rise
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 55% of instances where the trigger condition is met, or the Fed cuts rates within 3 months of signal activation.
